import unittest
from sqlglot import parse_one
from sqlglot.expressions import Insert

class TestInsertReplace(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_insert_replace_parsing(self):
        sql = """
        INSERT INTO TABLE students
            REPLACE USING (country)
            SELECT * FROM new_students;
        """
        parsed = parse_one(sql, dialect="databricks")
        self.assertIsInstance(parsed, Insert)
